purpose: Replace only the V45 logistic component family whose physical second moment was proved divergent by V47 with an identifiable five-component Gaussian mixture whose exponential moments exist, while holding the information, data, architecture, optimization, sampling, controls, and development gates fixed.

inherited_experiment.rule: inherit every V45 input, split, cached array, standardization, channel, architecture, optimizer, schedule, augmentation, donor identity, donor isometry, member pairing, sampling rule, evaluation threshold, fixed control, and firewall except the explicitly replaced component density, CDF, inverse-CDF bracket, and variance-preserving initial component scale

channels: V41 full extreme-structure block probability lifted from 16^3 to 64^3
V41 object log10 mean delta squared prediction broadcast over 64^3
conditioning.standardization: exact V45 train-only normalization loaded from the immutable V45 conditioning cache

target_and_likelihood.target: physical residual y_truth minus the frozen V14 corrected backbone
target_and_likelihood.standardization: exact V45 equal-source train-only scalar mean and standard deviation
target_and_likelihood.distribution: five-component continuous Gaussian mixture independently parameterized at every native voxel
target_and_likelihood.objective: equal-source mean exact continuous Gaussian-mixture negative log likelihood per voxel
target_and_likelihood.physical_moment_property: every finite Gaussian location and positive finite scale has finite E[10**(4.5*m*y)] for every finite real moment order m

network.output_weight_initialization: exactly zero for all 15 one-by-one convolution output rows
network.location_construction: standard-normal quantiles at midpoint probabilities 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9, unchanged from V45
network.scale_construction: choose one common Gaussian standard deviation so the equal-weight initial mixture has exactly zero mean and unit variance after the fixed softplus(raw)+0.01 transform
network.trainability: all output weights and all 15 biases remain trainable; asymmetric locations identify components at initialization and no component parameter is capped

training.mixed_precision: CUDA autocast plus GradScaler; mixture log probabilities remain float32
training.augmentation: uniform one of the same 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to all conditioning channels and target
training.validation: fixed diagnostic NLL at steps 4000, 8000, and 12000; never used for stopping, selection, or hyperparameter changes

sampling.candidate: same-voxel monotone Gaussian-mixture CDF inversion of the unchanged paired V31 donor conditional-rank field
sampling.mixture_inverse: exactly 28 vectorized bisection iterations with per-voxel finite Gaussian component quantile brackets at epsilon 1e-7
sampling.post_sample: undo the exact V45 train-only residual standardization and apply one exact residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone

matched_arms.identifiable_query_local_gaussian_mixtur: actual query-local parameters and unchanged paired donor ranks; the only selectable arm
matched_arms.rolled_parameter_control: periodically roll all 15 parameter fields by (16,8,4) native voxels while keeping query backbone and donor rank fixed
matched_arms.structure_risk_ablation: set the standardized V41 block-risk input channel to zero while retaining every other input and donor rank
matched_arms.common: identical query, donor, isometry, V31 rank field, backbone, fitted model, sampling arithmetic, and exact DC rule except for the named control change

development_evaluation.primary_pass: identifiable_query_local_gaussian_mixture_copula passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
high-k power and residual RMS pass every domain but Q3 or Q4 fails anywhere
rolled parameter control equals or improves candidate Q3 and Q4 jointly in every domain

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V47 result record, V45 program, and immutable V45 conditioning-cache hashes
prove the initial output biases equal the frozen values and the initial mixture mean and variance equal zero and one within 1e-6
prove every initial component location is distinct and same-role component gradients are nonidentical after one deterministic Gaussian-mixture likelihood backward pass
prove at least two component locations and scales diverge after two deterministic optimizer steps
analytically verify finite physical density first and second moments for every finite predicted Gaussian component parameter
network shape, parameter count, finite likelihood, nonzero finite gradients, and CDF inverse consistency
one real source-balanced GPU step with peak allocated memory below 24 GiB
one real paired-donor sample is finite, has no rank permutation, and residual DC below 1e-7
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
